description: Illustrative annualized earnings difference between two savings APYs for a given balance and horizon. Defaults: current = FDIC national average savings rate, comparison = highest RateZip-observed savings APY. States every omission (taxes, penalties, rate changes, tiers, availability). Not financial advice; never use the result to recommend an investment allocation.

comparison_apy_percent.description: APY to compare against (%); defaults to the highest RateZip-observed savings APY

current_apy_percent.description: APY the money earns today (%); defaults to the FDIC national average savings rate

name: calculate_deposit_earnings_difference
title: Illustrative deposit earnings difference
